pages.text: Loot a spell scroll, craft a spell book, inscribe, cast — Iron's Spellbooks is magic combat from your very first dungeon.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() First-available magic combat. Spell books and scrolls turn up in Overworld dungeons. The Dead King, Fire Boss, and Citadel Keeper are T2–T3 boss encounters from this mod.$(br2)$(bold)Battlemage synergy:$() Iron's Spellbooks is the primary mod for the Battlemage class. Mana Barrier and Arcane Infusion passives directly interact with ISS mana.

$(bold)Spellcasting schools:$() Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison, Blood, Eldritch, Holy, Ender, Nature. Not all schools are immediately accessible — higher-level books require finding them in dungeons.$(br2)$(bold)Mini-bosses:$() Archevoker, Cryomancer, Necromancer, and Pyromancer spawn in Overworld structures. They drop T2 token peeks and spell books.$(br2)$(bold)Keys:$() $(k:irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast) casts, $(k:irons_spellbooks.spell_wheel) opens the spell wheel.

$(bold)This pack upgrades the spell books themselves:$() caster classes start with $(l:icraft:mods_t1/modular_spells)Modular Spell Books$(/l) that take material pages and custom magic enchants.$(br2)$(bold)Next: work through $(l:icraft:mods_t1/early_magic)the Early Magic Tutorial$(/l) — scroll to first cast in five steps.$()
